changelog.title: Color coded content types
changelog.desc: Each content format now gets its own color on your planner cards, so a Reel, a Carousel, and a Post are easy to tell apart at a glance.

changelog.title: A better Writing Studio
changelog.desc: Choose Go Analog to write it yourself, or AI Draft for a guided, step by step flow. Either way, you can now send what you wrote straight into a content card with one click.
